en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-254 Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Isma’il narrated that Al-Nue’man ibn Abil Dalhas al-Baladi quoted Al-Hussein ibn Abdul Rahman, on the authority of Ubaydullah ibn Musa, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abi Layli that God’s Prophet (MGB) said,
“The truly sincere believers are three: Ali ibn Abi Talib (MGB), Habib - the carpenter , and the believer from the family of Pharaoh (Hizkil ).”
